note.label: The Image of Dysfunction or the Image of God Which One Are You?

precepts.why:
Daniel 7:27 says “the kingdom and dominion, and the greatness of the kingdom under the whole heaven, shall be given to the people of the saints of the most High, whose kingdom is an everlasting kingdom”. That is why Daniel 2:44 says the same: “And in the days of these kings shall the God of heaven set up a kingdom, which shall never be destroyed”.

The days of these kings are the same kings of Daniel 7, the thrones cast down in Armageddon when Christ comes back to smash and destroy and set his people up in rulership. The kingdom the God of heaven sets up is you, sisters and brothers, the nation of Israel, and it is starting now. A lot of people don't like that, but the Most High is building this kingdom right now, in the age of their decadence.

“and the kingdom shall not be left to other people, but it shall break in pieces and consume all these kingdoms”. The Most High's kingdom, the nation of Israel with Christ and the Most High and the angels leading us, shall break the nations and make them bend to the will of God, or death. Everybody is going to be made to follow the words of this Bible, its laws and commandments. Full stop.

“and it shall stand for ever.” That is the everlasting kingdom of Daniel 7:27. Remember these words: the kingdom the Lord is setting up shall stand for ever, and we are supposed to be in the image of understanding that, not the image of dysfunction. All the wealth of the nations under the whole heaven, the whole planet, has to be given back to Israel, including the nations themselves.

precepts.text: I beheld till the thrones were cast down. Daniel said he looked in the visions and he saw when the thrones — these same kingdoms that we are reading about here in the second chapter, he is bringing it out again in the seventh chapter with the dream. I beheld till the thrones were cast down, until the rulerships were destroyed. And the Ancient of days did sit. And God's judgment sat. Christ's judgment sat. And the Ancient of days, that is the Most High. Did sit. That is telling you something right there. Did sit. He had a body in order for him to sit. He had legs. He had a garment on. He sat down. And he had hair on his head. Whose garment was white as snow. He had a garment on because he had a body. You are talking about something, God does not have a body. Celestial bodies. God has that. If he had on a garment, he had a body. And the hair of his head — and if he had hair on his head, he had to have a body. In order for you to recognise that he sat down, you had to see him looking like a human, so you can understand. I know the Most High is the Most High, but he had a form for us to be able to describe him. He did not say he was a lizard. He did not say that he was some other creature. He said that he sat down and judged. So he had to be looking like a man type of figure, so you can understand. Like Exodus says, the Lord is a man of war. So he is looking like a man figure with all his power. The Ancient of days, meaning he was here before days began. That is the Most High. Whose garment was white as snow. He was not like a ghost or a sheet flying in the wind. He had a garment on that was on his body. And the hair of his head like the pure wool. Like the pure negro hair. Like the pure wool. That is our king. That is our creator. And his son looks just like him. So that is what is coming to us. So Daniel was looking and he saw these four great kings destroyed. He saw them destroyed, and then the Most High sat down and opened up the books and judged them. That is how that goes.
precepts.point: So when all of these kings are about to be done, and we are in the last part of this beast right now in America, listen. Shall the God of heaven set up a kingdom, which shall never be destroyed. So all of the other kingdoms are going to be destroyed. All of the other kingdoms were destroyed.

note.label: The Exponential Maturation In The Days Of Decadence

precepts.why:
“And in the days of these kings shall the God of heaven set up a kingdom”. These kings are all the kingdoms that ruled on this planet, the great image of Nebuchadnezzar's dream: Babylon the head of gold, then Persia, then Greece, then Rome, and America comes up last. We are in the last part of this beast right now, in America. All the other kingdoms were destroyed, and these are going to be destroyed.

Daniel brings the same kingdoms out again in the seventh chapter with his dream: “I beheld till the thrones were cast down”. Until the rulerships were destroyed. Daniel looked and saw these four great kings destroyed, and then the Most High sat down, opened the books and judged them. That is how it goes.

“and the Ancient of days did sit”. The Ancient of days means he was here before days began; that is the Most High, and his judgment sat. Did sit: that tells you something. He had a body in order to sit. He had legs, he had a garment on, he sat down, and he had hair on his head. People say God doesn't have a body; he has a celestial body. I know the Most High is the Most High, but he had a form so we could describe him. He didn't say he was a lizard or some other creature; he sat down and judged, so he looked like a man type of figure, the way the Lord is called a man of war.

“whose garment was white as snow”: he wasn't like a ghost or a sheet flying in the wind; the garment was on his body. “and the hair of his head like the pure wool”: like pure negro hair, white and woolly, black men's hair. That is our king, that is our creator, and his Son looks just like him. That is what is coming to us.

So in the days of these kings, while they are in rulership and the decadence is setting in, the Most High is causing us to get ourselves together, and persecution is part of that. When the thrones are cast down and the Ancient of days sits in judgment, the God of heaven sets up the kingdom that “shall not be left to other people”, other races and nations, but is for the twelve tribes of Israel, and it “shall break in pieces and consume all these kingdoms”. That is what Christ is going to do.

precepts.text: Alexander, son of Philip the Macedonian, smote Darius and reigned the first over Greece, made many wars, slew the kings of the earth, and was exalted; then he fell sick, parted his kingdom among his servants while yet alive, and evils were multiplied in the earth.
precepts.point: The kingdom shall not be left to other people; other races will be there, but ruling nothing. The stone is Christ, the chief cornerstone of Ephesians 2:20, and he will break these empires in pieces at the feet.
precepts.why:
Daniel tells Nebuchadnezzar that after the silver of Persia and Media shall come “another third kingdom of brass, which shall bear rule over all the earth.” What does it mean that this empire, the Greeks, would bear rule over all the earth? The first book of Maccabees shows it: “Alexander son of Philip, the Macedonian, who came out of the land of Chettiim, had smitten Darius king of the Persians and Medes, that he reigned in his stead, the first over Greece”. Out of Macedon came Philip, and his son Alexander was the one who united those Europeans, all the Edomite nations, together.

He “made many wars, and won many strong holds, and slew the kings of the earth, And went through to the ends of the earth, and took spoils of many nations, insomuch that the earth was quiet before him”. That is what Daniel meant by bearing rule over all the earth. “whereupon he was exalted and his heart was lifted up.” This is the beginning of white supremacy in the earth, the beginning of white power: they destroyed the dark nations, and the nations and kings “became tributaries unto him.” Everybody had to pay Alexander and the Greeks tribute.

“And after these things he fell sick, and perceived that he should die.” He got sick because of syphilis. He “parted his kingdom among them, while he was yet alive”, and after twelve years he died. There were other generals, but the four mightiest were Ptolemy, Lysimachus, Seleucus and Cassander, and they slaughtered the others, like Antigonus, and took his land. Ptolemy took Egypt, Seleucus had Syria, Cassander had Macedonia, and Lysimachus had Thrace and Asia Minor. That is how the empire was divided. “And after his death they all put crowns upon themselves; so did their sons after them many years: and evils were multiplied in the earth.”

Who was Alexander? The Chronology of Ancient Nations (1879) gives the pedigree of Philip, with Greek and Roman gods inserted to make them seem more important, running back through Eliphaz to Esau, Isaac and Abraham. The Rise of Christendom (1890) says King Philip was a descendant of Esau, son of Isaac. The scholars in the know know that Alexander was an Edomite; it is just our people who don't have a clue.

So the brass kingdom of the image is Esau ruling over all the earth, and it runs on into the iron of Rome and the feet of iron and clay, America and NATO, the last empire, still a continuation of Rome. The party isn't over, until the stone strikes the feet.

precepts.text: Built upon the foundation of the apostles and prophets, Jesus Christ himself being the chief corner stone. The stone is the King.
precepts.point: The kingdom shall not be left to other people; other races will be there, but ruling nothing. The stone is Christ, the chief cornerstone of Ephesians 2:20, and he will break these empires in pieces at the feet.
precepts.why:
Daniel saw “that the stone was cut out of the mountain without hands, and that it brake in pieces the iron, the brass, the clay, the silver, and the gold”. Inquiring minds want to know who this stone is, and Paul answers: “And are built upon the foundation of the apostles and prophets, Jesus Christ himself being the chief corner stone”. The chief cornerstone is the leader; that means he is the King. The stone is Christ.

“without hands” means without man's hands. “the great God hath made known to the king what shall come to pass hereafter: and the dream is certain, and the interpretation thereof sure.” Christ is coming to destroy these empires.

And where does the stone hit? It “smote the image upon his feet that were of iron and clay, and brake them to pieces.” That is Edom's Achilles heel. It is the promise from the beginning: “it shall bruise thy head, and thou shalt bruise his heel.” The feet are the last empire, America and NATO from 1776 until today. When the stone strikes there, “the iron, the clay, the brass, the silver, and the gold” are broken to pieces together and become “like the chaff of the summer threshingfloors; and the wind carried them away, that no place was found for them”.

“and the stone that smote the image became a great mountain, and filled the whole earth.” That great mountain is God's kingdom being established, the kingdom that “shall never be destroyed: and the kingdom shall not be left to other people”. Other races will be there, but they won't be ruling a thing. We are living in the days of these kings, and what you see here is the beginning of God's kingdom. You might kill millions of us, but this truth is going to continue, because the King it is built on is the chief corner stone.

precepts.text: Every kingdom divided against itself is brought to desolation; if Satan be divided against himself, how shall his kingdom stand?
precepts.point: The fourth kingdom, Rome extended in Europe and America, is strong as iron but mixed with miry clay. The kingdom shall be divided, partly strong and partly broken.

note.label: Civil War & the Son of Perdition

precepts.why:
The fourth kingdom “shall be strong as iron” is Rome, and Europe and America are the extension of Rome. Strong as iron means strong militarily. But Daniel goes on: in the feet and toes, “part of potters’ clay, and part of iron, the kingdom shall be divided; but there shall be in it of the strength of the iron”. They have that same military strength Rome had, yet “the kingdom shall be partly strong, and partly broken.” Why broken? Because they are divided. That is what you see taking place right now: America is divided.

Christ said it: “Every kingdom divided against itself is brought to desolation; and a house divided against a house falleth.” A lot of times we use this for when we were divided in Jerusalem, and it is. But it is also speaking of the last days, of the kingdom that is set up in the last days, and it tells us what happens before its destruction.

Read on: “If Satan also be divided against himself, how shall his kingdom stand?” Which kingdom is Satan's kingdom? Europe and America. America and Europe are divided; that alliance is falling apart. Here in America the citizens are divided. Satan is divided against himself, and that is a sign that they are about to fall. How can his kingdom stand? It can't.

The same division is prophesied of Egypt, and America is spiritually called Egypt: “I will set the Egyptians against the Egyptians: and they shall fight every one against his brother, and every one against his neighbour; city against city, and kingdom against kingdom.” White people will be fighting white people, city against city, the same way the South fought against the North in the Civil War. The Lord is behind all of it.

So the iron kingdom of Daniel 2:40 is strong, but its own division is what brings it to desolation. The civil war things are already going on, even in the drawing of new districts between Texas and California to hold the House and the Senate. Pay attention: a house divided against a house falls.

So never think that we are not special. Christ did not come to die for everybody. He only died for the Israelites, so he could bring us back to the Father, and from there the kingdom is set up.

That is what you see right now: we are repenting and starting to know who we are, Judah, Benjamin, Levi, Ephraim, Simeon, coming out of that filthy Christian church, stopping the stealing and the adultery. note.label: Genesis 40: Do Not Interpretations Belong to God

precepts.why:
“The king answered unto Daniel, and said, Of a truth it is, that your God is a God of gods, and a Lord of kings, and a revealer of secrets, seeing thou couldest reveal this secret.” Daniel stood in Babylon in the same understanding Joseph had in the prison, and even the king of Babylon had to confess it: Daniel’s God is a God of gods and a revealer of secrets.

The butler and the baker said, “We have dreamed a dream, and there is no interpreter of it.” Joseph answered on another level: “Do not interpretations belong to God?” They do. The same God that gave Joseph the interpretations gave them to Daniel. Joseph already understood that these things belong to the Most High, and that is why he could say, tell me them.

“Which shall never be destroyed”: this is why we are so bold to say, white man, you can’t stop this. It don’t matter who he kill amongst us, he can’t stop this truth, this teaching.
